scope: Paired ablation of explicit multihorizon vessel-aware obstacle trajectories; identical 172D architecture and unchanged physics/reward
authorization: User requests improve pure reinforcement learning through experiments before adding any world model
transition_unit: one environment control step, not individual robot samples
comparability: Both arms explicitly expand the same per-seed EXP30 B 500K weights from 76 to172 dimensions, preserving the first76 columns and zeroing the96 new columns. MASKED zeros only the appended trajectory features; both use identical optimizer/RNG/layout streams and original exploration settings.
task_limit: Controlled in-vitro goal-conditioned ideal-actuator simulation with perfect state. All object positions randomized on fixed MCA anatomy. Soft overlap costs, not hard collision physics. Diagnostic clearance feasibility is not collision-free policy performance or hardware verification.
